description: This Java source file defines the 'Record' class, which models a data record with fields, supports parsing and formatting of fixed-length and delimited data, and manages relationships with parent and child records within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: Record
classes.description: Represents a data record with fields, supports serialization, parsing, and formatting for fixed-length and delimited data, and manages hierarchical relationships.

methods.description: Returns the name of the record.

methods.description: Returns the associated ModelRecord object.
